'''Animated adamant armour''' is a player-created foe encountered at the [[Warriors' Guild]]. To summon one, players must use an [[adamant platebody]], [[adamant platelegs]], and an [[adamant full helm]] on the [[magical animator]]. It is not recommended to farm animated adamant for [[warrior token]]s due to its high defensive stats.

Since the animated adamant armour is the second most powerful version, it's a good idea for lower levelled players to bring plenty of food, and slash resistant armour. The player will retain all of their [[adamant armour]] pieces when it is defeated; however, any armour below [[Animated Black Armour|black]] has a chance to lose parts. 

Like all other animated armour variants, it is immune to [[Ranged]] and [[Magic]] attacks. As a result of being immune to Ranged damage, the armour is effectively immune to [[burn]], which will be inflicted but reduced to 0 damage. It is also immune to [[poison]] and [[venom]].
